notLacuna: No other Hebrew is dropped in this work. After patching, `( )` occurs zero times in the chunked Latin and there is no `, ,`.

⭐ THE ( ) SWEEP IS NOT SUFFICIENT ON ITS OWN AND THIS BOOK PROVES IT. Four of the seven sites left an empty ( ); the other three left only WHITESPACE -- a double space before a comma (0219A) and a triple space mid-sentence (0296A), plus the book-title line, which left no scar at all because the whole line went. A work whose scars are all whitespace would pass a ( ) grep silently. Grep for runs of two or more spaces as well, and read the head of the book against the plate.

The Greek is a separate question and is NOT dropped: 15 <foreign xml:lang="greek"> spans survive in the TEI. The only Greek that went missing is the ΕΞΟΔΟΣ of the book-title line, which went with the whole line.
